citations.narrative:
The black vulture had algae on the bottom of its water receptacle. The water also appeared green with organic matter.
Water and water receptacles that are not kept clean and sanitary can have an adverse effect on the health and well-being
of the birds. Water receptacles must be kept clean and sanitized in accordance with § 3.158 as often as necessary to
keep them clean and free of contamination.
Correct by July 30, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
